title: Verify origin trunk and detach membership from detail proofs

intentCoverage.report:
Checked revision 11264ea38b4a45592ff54328f60ef90a33899870. Verdict: Caught. No follow-up.

**Verdict.** Caught.

**Next proof action.** None for this promise on the observed path. The maintained request-list equality already fails when the named detail read is absent.

**Story and revision.** SEED-430#open-and-refresh-board-at-verified-trunk, section "Open the published Board at verified Git trunk", at `11264ea38b4a45592ff54328f60ef90a33899870`. Plan `.planning/slice-plans/828-open-and-refresh-board-at-verified-trunk/PLAN.md` slice 3, "Prove detail and recovery reads apart from membership".

**Promise.** In the slice 3 E2E cases, the compared request list leaves the REST membership read (`ref main`) out and still requires the detail, credit, or recovery reads that case promises. A missing promised detail read must fail the maintained assertion.

**Fault.** Validated the suggested probe and kept the suggested spec and command. The fault was placed in product code so the fixture and the assertion stayed intact. In `dashboard/src/observationOutcomes.ts`, `shouldAsk` no longer returned true for `isEligibleUnanswered(settled)`. A fresh read therefore skipped an eligible transient failure. Rate-limit gaps (`failed` with `resumesAt`) and never-settled questions were still asked. That omitted the recovery content read `content .planning/seeds/SEED-264-unreachable.md@<revision>` while the equality still named it. The withheld-seed and planned-plan content reads still occurred.

**Fixture.** None. The spec's existing limit fixture and `noConnection` answer for the unreachable seed were unchanged.

**Maintained check.** `e2e/observation/limit-recovery-detail.spec.ts`, test "withheld detail is read on its own once the wait ends on a visible page, beside the snapshot it keeps, while a gap another failure left stays", step "GitHub was asked which commit the ref names and for the withheld records, besides the record another failure keeps unread, which stays a gap". The catch is `toEqual` at line 123 on `readsBesideChecks(github.calls.slice(asked)).filter((read) => read !== "ref main").sort()`.

**Command.** `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:e2e -- e2e/observation/limit-recovery-detail.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line` in an isolated worktree of `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough` detached at the revision (`/tmp/dough-intent-coverage/11264ea38`). Default timeout. `test.slow()` was not used. The execution worktree was not edited.

**Reach.** Baseline before the fault: 1 passed (14.9s), so the request-list step ran green. With the fault, the failure is inside that third step. The hidden-page step and the visible-recovery step had already passed, including the healed withheld detail, the planned plan text, and the remaining unreachable gap.

**Wrong behavior.** The compared list after filtering `ref main` was missing `content .planning/seeds/SEED-264-unreachable.md@b9deedefd46bfce559255869790641314d70137e`. Received still contained `content .planning/seeds/SEED-264-withheld.md@b9deedefd46bfce559255869790641314d70137e` and `content .planning/slice-plans/264-planned/PLAN.md@b9deedefd46bfce559255869790641314d70137e`. `ref main` was absent from that compared received list. The equality failed because the named unreachable-seed content read was absent (expected one fewer entry).

**Restoration.** `git checkout -- dashboard/src/observationOutcomes.ts` restored `shouldAsk`. Tracked diff was empty. HEAD stayed `11264ea38b4a45592ff54328f60ef90a33899870`. Status matched the pre-probe record (`?? node_modules` only; test output is gitignored). The same command then passed: 1 passed (6.8s). The scratch worktree was removed with `git worktree remove --force`.

**Prior disposition.** Slice 3 is already recorded done, with these list edits accepted on REST. This probe confirms that equality on the observed path. It does not decide a new repair.
